service.description: Money is for ADMIN and the holders of TIME_ENTRY_RATE (design-projects.md §1.1: the Projects managers); anyone else gets an error, or with need none only the answer.

actions.script: managesMoney = !!ec.user.userId && (ec.user.isInGroup('ADMIN') || ec.user.hasPermission('TIME_ENTRY_RATE')) if (!managesMoney && need !== 'none') ec.message.addError(ec.l10n.localize('Only those who manage money see billing'))

service.description: The invoices of projects among the projects the user sees (every project for ADMIN), by kind: client (to a project's client: linked by WorkEffortInvoice or billing its time, TimeEntry.invoiceId), worker (a worker's time, TimeEntry.vendorInvoiceId) or expense (linked by WorkEffortInvoice, from someone else). invoiceIds narrows to those; rootWorkEffortId to one project. invoiceMap: invoiceId to {kind, projectIds}. No money check: the callers make it.

Whether the user may see an invoice in Projects: one who manages money (check#Money) and sees one of its projects (get#InvoiceProjects); else "not available" as an error, or with need none only the answer. kind: client, worker or expense.

Unbilled's Client billing list (design-projects.md §10 UnbilledList): by project, the billable time not invoiced (mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#UnbilledSummary) with its texts: the client, the billing basis, hours and amount, the approved part ready to invoice, what waits for approval, entries without a rate, the period, the last invoice, the drafts, and whether it may be invoiced now (and why not); the totals and the clients for the find. Those who do not manage money get an error.

service.description: CreateProjectInvoice's dialog (design-projects.md §10): a project's approved billable time not invoiced, entry by entry with its rate and amount (those without a rate flagged), and what waits for approval; the client's open drafts of the project to add to; the grouping (the project's WstInvoiceGrouping: per entry, per worker, one line) and the payment terms (the organization's ProjBillingDefaults settlementTermId) to default to. For one who manages money and manages the project.

Unbilled's Create invoice (design-projects.md §10 CreateProjectInvoice): a client invoice of a project's approved billable time (mantle.account.InvoiceServices.create#ProjectInvoiceItems with approvedOnly and billableOnly), the selected entries only when timeEntryIds is given, added to an open draft of the project to the same client (invoiceId) or a new one dated invoiceDate with the payment terms; the grouping per entry, per worker or one line (entryGrouping). The project's expenses not billed through go with it. For one who manages money and manages the project; refused when the project has no client or vendor, a selected entry is not approved, invoiced already or has no rate. All or nothing, in one transaction.

parameter.name: timeEntryIds
parameter.description: The selected entries: a list or a comma list.

parameter.name: selection
parameter.description: The dialog's selection: none selected is an error rather than all.

service.description: Invoices (design-projects.md §10 Invoices): the invoices of the projects the user sees (get#InvoiceProjects), for one who manages money. Chips with counts: Drafts (In-Process, or a worker's Incoming and Received), To send (approved, Finalized), Sent (Sent, Acknowledged), Overdue (approved or sent, unpaid, past due), Paid, Worker invoices, All (cancelled ones too). The find: project, client, kind, status, and an invoice date period. Each row: the invoice, its kind, projects, from, to, date, due, total, unpaid and the status chip, newest first.

InvoiceDetail in the Projects context (design-projects.md §10 InvoiceDetail): for one who manages money and sees one of its projects (get#InvoiceAccess), else detail is null. The header (from, to, dates, terms, status, reference, description, message, totals), the lines with the time behind each (mantle.account.InvoiceServices.get#InvoiceTimeDetail: who, when, work item, hours, rate, amount, comment), the projects, the payments applied, the email address to send it to (the client's billing email, else its billing contact's or its own primary one) and the moves the user may make: approve (In-Process to Finalized), send (approves first), resume changes (Finalized to In-Process), cancel (In-Process or Finalized: frees its time), edit and remove a line (In-Process). Worker and expense invoices are read only here.

InvoiceDetail's moves on a client invoice of a project (get#InvoiceAccess): approve (In-Process to Finalized: posted to the ledger when the organization keeps one), resume (Finalized back to In-Process), cancel (In-Process or Finalized: its time is unbilled again, mantle.account.InvoiceServices.cancel#Invoice through its rule). In one transaction.

InvoiceDetail's Edit on a draft client invoice: the invoice date, payment terms (the due date follows), reference, description and the message to the client (mantle.account.InvoiceServices.update#Invoice).
InvoiceDetail's Remove on a line of a draft client invoice (mantle.account.InvoiceServices.delete#InvoiceItem): its time is unbilled again.

InvoiceDetail's Send (design-projects.md §10, §14): a client invoice by email to toAddresses (the client's billing address by default) from the vendor's billing address, with the printed invoice and its time detail as a PDF (the PDF is left out, logged, when the server cannot make one) and the lines in the message; a draft is approved first, and an approved invoice becomes Sent. The approval and the status change are one transaction; the email itself waits in the Outbox when the mail server does not take it, which is said.

The printed client invoice (design-projects.md §14; style-guide §8 Print documents): the vendor and its address, the client and its billing address, the invoice number, dates, terms and reference, the lines and the total, the message, and when the project keeps time detail on its invoices (WstTimeDetail, Y unless set N) the time behind each line (day, who, work item, hours, rate, amount, comment); every value escaped. For one who may see the invoice (get#InvoiceAccess); printHtml says it is not available otherwise. summaryText: the lines as text, for an email's plain part.

service.description: Rates (design-projects.md §10 Rates): the RateAmount rows of client billing (RaprClient) or worker pay (RaprVendor) on the projects the user sees or on none (a person's, a work type's or everyone's), for one who manages money. The find: project, person, work type, position class, rate type, and effective on a day (else the current and coming rates; ended ones with showEnded). Each row: the rate type, project, person, position class, work type, from, thru, amount and currency, whether it is current, coming or ended.

Rates' New rate and Edit (design-projects.md §10 NewRate, RateList), for one who manages money. A new rate (mantle.humanres.RateServices.create#RateAmount): its purpose, rate type, project (one the user sees, or none), person, position class, work type, from (today by default), thru, amount and currency, per hour. An edit (rateAmountId; mantle.humanres.RateServices.update#RateAmount) changes only the dates and the amount: to change what a rate applies to, end it and add another. A rate of a project the user does not see is refused. Rates found for time entries already are kept on them (TimeEntry.rateAmountId): an amount changed here changes what their time not yet invoiced bills at (ProjectTime's Update rates finds the rates again).
Rates' End: a rate ends now (thruDate), for one who manages money; the time already logged keeps it.
The choices of Rates' forms: the open projects the user sees (not templates), the work types offered (WorkType), the position classes and the rate types (RateType, Standard first).

Rates' Which rate (design-projects.md §10 WhichRate): the client and the worker rate that apply to a person's time on a project or work item, of a work type, on a day (mantle.work.TimeServices.find#RateAmount, as a time entry finds its rates), and why: what the rate found is scoped to. For one who manages money.

BillingSettings (design-projects.md §12): the organization's billing defaults for its projects (PartySetting ProjBillingDefaults, a JSON object; mantle.work.ProjectServices.get#ProjectSettings reads the keys of the project settings WstBillingBasis billingBasis, WstInvoiceGrouping invoiceGrouping, WstTimeDetail timeDetail and WstShareHours shareHours): billingBasis (TimeAndMaterials, FixedPrice, Milestones, NotBilled), invoiceGrouping (PerEntry, PerWorker, OneLine), timeDetail (time detail on invoices), shareHours (hours shared with clients), settlementTermId (the payment terms of a new invoice) and workerInvoicing (Monthly or ByProject: how contractors bill their time). The organization is the settings one (ironstone.ProjectServices.get#SettingsOrganization) unless organizationPartyId is given.

BillingSettings' form, for the Projects managers who manage money: the organization's ProjBillingDefaults (a JSON object under the 255 characters of a PartySetting, impl-projects.md F9). Each project may set its own billing basis, grouping, time detail and shared hours (its Settings, WorkEffortSetting rows), which win over these.
Home's Unbilled counter text (design-projects.md §3): get#ProjectHomeCounts unbilledAmount formatted in its currency; empty when it is null (not one who manages money).
